name: liveStartBoundaries
sql:
SELECT h.domain, c.height::text AS height, encode(c.hash, 'hex') AS hash,
  encode(h.mailbox, 'hex') AS mailbox,
  encode(h.merkle_tree_hook, 'hex') AS merkle_tree_hook,
  encode(h.interchain_gas_paymaster, 'hex') AS interchain_gas_paymaster
       FROM scraper_head h JOIN scraper_checkpoint c
         ON c.domain=h.domain AND c.height=h.confirmed_height
       WHERE h.healthy AND NOT h.halted

name: liveStartBoundaries:domains
sql:
SELECT h.domain, c.height::text AS height, encode(c.hash, 'hex') AS hash,
  encode(h.mailbox, 'hex') AS mailbox,
  encode(h.merkle_tree_hook, 'hex') AS merkle_tree_hook,
  encode(h.interchain_gas_paymaster, 'hex') AS interchain_gas_paymaster

         ON c.domain=h.domain AND c.height=h.confirmed_height
       WHERE h.healthy AND NOT h.halted
         AND h.domain=ANY($1::integer[])

name: confirmationSnapshots
sql:
SELECT h.domain, h.head_height, h.indexed_height, h.confirmed_height,
                  requested.confirmations, c.height::text AS height, encode(c.hash, 'hex') AS hash,
  encode(h.mailbox, 'hex') AS mailbox,
  encode(h.merkle_tree_hook, 'hex') AS merkle_tree_hook,
  encode(h.interchain_gas_paymaster, 'hex') AS interchain_gas_paymaster
           FROM unnest($1::integer[], $2::bigint[]) requested(domain, confirmations)
           JOIN scraper_head h ON h.domain=requested.domain
           LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
             SELECT height, hash FROM scraper_checkpoint
             WHERE domain=h.domain AND height<=LEAST(h.indexed_height,h.head_height-requested.confirmations)
             ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1
           ) c ON h.healthy AND NOT h.halted

name: messageChanges
sql:
/* confirmation_messages */ SELECT * FROM (
          (SELECT origin_block_height AS height, 0 AS source, id, msg_id FROM raw_message_dispatch
            WHERE origin_domain=$1 AND origin_block_height>=$2::bigint AND origin_block_height<=$5::bigint
              AND (origin_block_height,0,id)>($2::bigint,$3::integer,$4::bigint)
            ORDER BY origin_block_height, id LIMIT $6)
          UNION ALL (SELECT block_number, 1, id, msg_id FROM delivered_message
            WHERE domain=$1 AND block_number>=$2::bigint AND block_number<=$5::bigint
              AND (block_number,1,id)>($2::bigint,$3::integer,$4::bigint)
            ORDER BY block_number, id LIMIT $6)
          UNION ALL (SELECT block_number, 2, id, msg_id FROM gas_payment
            WHERE domain=$1 AND block_number>=$2::bigint AND block_number<=$5::bigint
              AND (block_number,2,id)>($2::bigint,$3::integer,$4::bigint)
            ORDER BY block_number, id LIMIT $6)
        ) changes ORDER BY height, source, id LIMIT $6

name: messageFacts
sql:
/* live_message_facts */
  WITH dispatches AS (
    SELECT id, msg_id, nonce, origin_domain, destination_domain, time_created,
      sender, recipient, origin_mailbox, origin_tx_hash, origin_block_hash,
      origin_block_height, msg_body
    FROM raw_message_dispatch WHERE msg_id=ANY($1::bytea[])
    UNION ALL
    -- Historical/legacy messages can predate raw dispatch storage. Still
    -- project their delivery/payment updates through the selected frontiers.
    SELECT message.id, message.msg_id, message.nonce, message.origin,
      message.destination, message.time_created, message.sender,
      message.recipient, message.origin_mailbox, tx.hash, block.hash,
      block.height, message.msg_body
    FROM message
    JOIN "transaction" tx ON tx.id=message.origin_tx_id
    JOIN block ON block.id=tx.block_id
    WHERE message.msg_id=ANY($1::bytea[])
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_message_dispatch raw
        WHERE raw.msg_id=message.msg_id)
  ), eligible_dispatch AS (SELECT * FROM dispatches)
  SELECT delivery.domain AS delivery_domain, delivery.block_number AS delivery_height,
    payment.buckets AS payment_buckets,
    CASE WHEN canonical.id IS NOT NULL THEN canonical.msg_body ELSE dispatch.msg_body END AS message_body,
    
    coalesce(canonical.id, dispatch.id) AS id,
    dispatch.msg_id,
    dispatch.nonce,
    delivery.id IS NOT NULL AS is_delivered,
    dispatch.origin_domain AS origin_domain_id,
    origin_domain.chain_id AS origin_chain_id,
    origin_domain.name AS origin_domain,
    dispatch.destination_domain AS destination_domain_id,
    destination_domain.chain_id AS destination_chain_id,
    destination_domain.name AS destination_domain,
    dispatch.time_created AS send_scraped_at,
    origin_block.timestamp AS send_occurred_at,
    delivery.time_created AS delivery_scraped_at,
    destination_block.timestamp AS delivery_occurred_at,
    destination_block.timestamp-origin_block.timestamp AS delivery_latency,
    dispatch.time_created-origin_block.timestamp AS send_scape_latency,
    delivery.time_created-destination_block.timestamp AS delivery_scape_latency,
    dispatch.sender,
    dispatch.recipient,
    dispatch.origin_mailbox,
    delivery.destination_mailbox,
    origin_tx.id AS origin_tx_id,
    coalesce(origin_tx.hash, dispatch.origin_tx_hash) AS origin_tx_hash,
    origin_tx.gas_limit AS origin_tx_gas_limit,
    origin_tx.max_priority_fee_per_gas AS origin_tx_max_priority_fee_per_gas,
    origin_tx.max_fee_per_gas AS origin_tx_max_fee_per_gas,
    origin_tx.gas_price AS origin_tx_gas_price,
    origin_tx.effective_gas_price AS origin_tx_effective_gas_price,
    origin_tx.nonce AS origin_tx_nonce,
    origin_tx.sender AS origin_tx_sender,
    origin_tx.recipient AS origin_tx_recipient,
    origin_tx.gas_used AS origin_tx_gas_used,
    origin_tx.cumulative_gas_used AS origin_tx_cumulative_gas_used,
    origin_block.id AS origin_block_id,
    dispatch.origin_block_height,
    origin_block.hash AS origin_block_hash,
    destination_tx.id AS destination_tx_id,
    coalesce(destination_tx.hash, delivery.transaction_hash) AS destination_tx_hash,
    destination_tx.gas_limit AS destination_tx_gas_limit,
    destination_tx.max_priority_fee_per_gas AS destination_tx_max_priority_fee_per_gas,
    destination_tx.max_fee_per_gas AS destination_tx_max_fee_per_gas,
    destination_tx.gas_price AS destination_tx_gas_price,
    destination_tx.effective_gas_price AS destination_tx_effective_gas_price,
    destination_tx.nonce AS destination_tx_nonce,
    destination_tx.sender AS destination_tx_sender,
    destination_tx.recipient AS destination_tx_recipient,
    destination_tx.gas_used AS destination_tx_gas_used,
    destination_tx.cumulative_gas_used AS destination_tx_cumulative_gas_used,
    destination_block.id AS destination_block_id,
    coalesce(delivery.block_number, destination_block.height) AS destination_block_height,
    coalesce(delivery.block_hash, destination_block.hash) AS destination_block_hash
  
  FROM eligible_dispatch dispatch
  LEFT JOIN message canonical ON canonical.msg_id=dispatch.msg_id
  LEFT JOIN "transaction" canonical_origin_tx ON canonical_origin_tx.id=canonical.origin_tx_id
  LEFT JOIN block raw_origin_block ON raw_origin_block.domain=dispatch.origin_domain
    AND raw_origin_block.hash=dispatch.origin_block_hash
  JOIN block origin_block ON origin_block.id=coalesce(raw_origin_block.id, canonical_origin_tx.block_id)
    AND origin_block.timestamp IS NOT NULL

  LEFT JOIN domain origin_domain ON origin_domain.id=dispatch.origin_domain
  LEFT JOIN domain destination_domain ON destination_domain.id=dispatch.destination_domain
  LEFT JOIN "transaction" origin_tx ON origin_tx.block_id=origin_block.id
    AND origin_tx.hash=dispatch.origin_tx_hash

  -- delivered_message.msg_id is unique, so each message has at most one delivery.
  LEFT JOIN delivered_message delivery ON delivery.msg_id=dispatch.msg_id
  LEFT JOIN "transaction" identified_destination_tx
    ON identified_destination_tx.id=delivery.destination_tx_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT b.* FROM block b WHERE b.domain=delivery.domain AND b.hash=delivery.block_hash
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.* FROM block b WHERE delivery.block_hash IS NULL
      AND b.domain=delivery.domain AND b.id=identified_destination_tx.block_id
  ) destination_block ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT identified_destination_tx.* WHERE delivery.destination_tx_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT tx.* FROM "transaction" tx WHERE delivery.destination_tx_id IS NULL
      AND tx.block_id=destination_block.id AND tx.hash=delivery.transaction_hash
  ) destination_tx ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT json_agg(b) AS buckets FROM (
      SELECT domain, max(block_number)::text AS height, count(*)::text AS count,
        sum(payment)::text AS payment, sum(gas_amount)::text AS gas
      FROM (SELECT domain, block_number, payment, gas_amount, least(
          dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY domain ORDER BY block_number),
          dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY domain ORDER BY block_number DESC NULLS LAST)
        ) AS rank FROM gas_payment WHERE msg_id=dispatch.msg_id) p
      -- payForGas is permissionless. Keep the oldest and newest heights per
      -- domain exact and fold the middle into one bucket, visible once its
      -- newest payment is. NULL-height legacy payments are always visible.
      GROUP BY domain, block_number IS NULL,
        CASE WHEN rank<=8 THEN block_number END
    ) b
  ) payment ON TRUE
